structured_data.title: Alice in Wonderland
structured_data.description: Alice, an unpretentious and individual 19-year-old, is betrothed to a dunce of an English nobleman. At her engagement party, she escapes the crowd to consider whether to go through with the marriage and falls down a hole in the garden after spotting an unusual rabbit. Arriving in a strange and surreal place called "Underland," she finds herself in a world that resembles the nightmares she had as a child, filled with talking animals, villainous queens and knights, and frumious bandersnatches. Alice realizes that she is there for a reason--to conquer the horrific Jabberwocky and restore the rightful queen to her throne.

The year is 1903 and Lewis Carroll's classic novel, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, gets its first adaptation. Just over 8 (badly damaged) minutes survive from the original 12, so the incoherency of the ''nonsense literature'' source is even further increased. That said, considering its era, the (compressed) imagination the filmmakers tried to capture is nevertheless admirable.
